items.followUp: Define chemical energy and gravitational potential energy.

rubric.why: Geothermal energy is heat energy from the Earth's interior.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as heat or thermal energy obtained from inside the Earth.

rubric.why: Elastic potential energy is stored in an elastic object when it is stretched, compressed or otherwise deformed.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking stored energy in an elastic object to stretching, compression or deformation.

modelAnswer: Geothermal energy is heat energy obtained from the interior of the Earth.
Elastic potential energy is the energy stored in an elastic object when it is stretched, compressed or otherwise deformed.
